title: VC guide: credential oracle reference architecture section
description: Add implementation-neutral section to jmap-chat-vc-guide.md describing a server-side credential oracle (Mark's jmapd vision; jmapd not yet created): narrow interface (DID + Space -> roles + expiry), mapping file (trusted issuers, credential type -> SpaceRole, scope, re-check interval, explicit unreachable-oracle behaviour), consult points (provisioning, multi-account create, addMembers/role assignment, periodic re-check), backends (holder presentation, published credentials via did:webs, TRQP registry lookup). Deployment pattern; no draft changes.
close_reason: Added §9 Reference architecture: a credential oracle to jmap-chat-vc-guide.md; Non-goals renumbered §10
